seg.seg_note: Five segments: Test & Measurement, Environmental, Life Sciences & Diagnostics, Dental, Industrial Technologies (+ 'Businesses contributed to Apex joint venture' row = equity-method earnings of Apex 66.8 in 2011, no sales; + Other = unallocated corporate). Beckman Coulter (control 24-Jun-2011, closed 30-Jun-2011) in Life Sciences & Diagnostics. Industrial Technologies recast for PSA (sold Apr-2011), Accu-Sort (ASI) and KEO (held for sale; sold Jan/Feb-2012) as discontinued operations. Segment data from 10-K Note 20 ($m, identical to release). Growth components from 10-K MD&A segment tables, additive presentation (existing businesses = core; acquisitions positive). Total-company 'Acquisitions' 18.5 is net of the reduction in revenues from the 2010 Apex contribution (release label 'Acquisitions (net of reduction in revenues relating to Apex JV)'). Segment D&A only combined (extra.seg_extra); identifiable assets include assets held for sale. 2011 restructuring charges by segment (MD&A): T&M 18.8, Env 7.5, LS&D 100.9, Dental 28.3, IT 23.8.

eps_bridge: Loss on Early Extinguishment of Debt
item_amounts: Acquisition-related transaction costs deemed significant ($26m pre-tax), fair value adjustments to acquisition related inventory and deferred revenue balances and change-in-control payments to employees of Beckman Coulter ($139m pre-tax) ("Acquisition Related Costs")
Loss on early extinguishment of debt resulting from "make whole" payments associated with the retirement of certain of the acquired Beckman Coulter debt ("Loss on Early Extinguishment of Debt")
Reversal of reserve relating to legal contingency ("Reversal of Legal Contingency Reserve")
Gains from net reduction in income tax reserves, other discrete tax items and reduction of effective tax rate ("Income Tax Items")
ngaap.guidance: Q1-12 diluted net EPS $0.66-$0.71; FY2012 diluted net EPS guidance of $3.20-$3.35 reaffirmed.
ngaap.notes: From 2011 the adjusted measures are on a continuing-operations basis ('Adjusted Net Earnings from Continuing Operations'). Excludes significant acquisition transaction costs, acquisition fair value adjustments to inventory / deferred revenue and Beckman change-in-control payments, make-whole loss on retiring Beckman debt, a legal reserve reversal and discrete tax items. Amortization of intangibles is NOT added back (amort_pretax null). Adjusted net earnings from continuing ops 1,979.1 (2010: 1,489.6). FCF = operating cash flow from continuing operations less purchases of PP&E. Pretax amounts from item descriptions (approximate $m); after-tax from the reconciliation ($000s).
